preferences.preference: Hotel room quality and staff service
preferences.description: Travelers value clean accommodations, overall value, and attentive or professional hotel staff behavior.
Travelers enjoy visiting scenic sea beaches, coral islands, and coastal destinations across Bangladesh.
Travelers explore ancient forts, museums, mosques, and UNESCO World Heritage sites reflecting the country's history.
Travelers seek panoramic mountain vistas, peaceful atmospheres, and viewpoints like Nilachal in the hill tracts.
Travelers visit Sonargaon to explore ancient ruins and unique 19th-century colonial architecture in Panam City.
Travelers experience lush green hills, tea cultivation, and peaceful nature getaways in the tea capital.
Travelers enjoy unique boat ride experiences and seasonal water landscapes at the Ratargul Swamp Forest.
Travelers take short eco-tourism day trips from Mongla to experience the Sundarbans mangrove forest gateway.

preferences.preference: Kaptai Lake and Rangamati scenic tours
preferences.description: Travelers appreciate the breathtaking natural beauty, peaceful lake views, and scenic landscapes of Rangamati.
